concepts.title: Line Symmetry
concepts.definition: A figure has line symmetry if there is a line about which the figure can be folded so the two parts coincide. The line is called the line or axis of symmetry.
concepts.formula: line symmetry: fold line -> two halves coincide
concepts.key_idea: Fold along line, two halves match.

solution_steps.explain: Look for a line that divides the figure into two matching halves
Fold along the line - the two halves should coincide
A figure may have one or multiple lines of symmetry; check all possible fold lines (vertical, horizontal, diagonal) and count how many produce matching halves

concepts.title: Lines of Symmetry for Regular Polygons
concepts.definition: A regular polygon has all sides equal and all angles equal. Each regular polygon has as many lines of symmetry as it has sides. Equilateral triangle: 3, square: 4, pentagon: 5, hexagon: 6.
concepts.formula: lines of symmetry = number of sides (for regular polygon)
concepts.key_idea: Regular polygon: lines of symmetry = number of sides.

lines of symmetry for regular polygon

solution_steps.explain: All sides equal and all angles equal?
Number of sides = number of lines of symmetry
Circle has infinite lines of symmetry (every diameter)

concepts.title: Mirror Reflection Symmetry
concepts.definition: Line symmetry is related to mirror reflection. A shape has line symmetry when one half is the mirror image of the other. The mirror line is the line of symmetry. Left-right orientation changes in mirror reflection.
concepts.formula: line symmetry = mirror reflection; left-right changes
concepts.key_idea: Mirror line = line of symmetry. Left-right reverses.
question_patterns: is dotted line a mirror line

solution_steps.explain: Each point reflects across the mirror line

concepts.title: Rotational Symmetry
concepts.definition: Rotation turns an object about a fixed point (centre of rotation) by an angle (angle of rotation). If after rotation the object looks exactly the same, it has rotational symmetry. Order = number of times it looks the same in a full 360 degree turn.
concepts.formula: order = 360 / angle of rotation; order = times looks same in 360
concepts.key_idea: Rotates and looks same. Order = 360 / angle.

solution_steps.explain: The fixed point about which object rotates
Smallest angle where it looks the same

concepts.title: Line Symmetry and Rotational Symmetry
concepts.definition: Some shapes have only line symmetry, some only rotational, some both. Square has 4 lines of symmetry and rotational symmetry of order 4. Circle has infinite lines and rotational symmetry for any angle.
concepts.formula: may have: line only, rotational only, or both
concepts.key_idea: Shapes can have line, rotational, or both symmetries.
